title: TaskCreate Metadata — Tier 3 (Minimal, special nesting)
description: Minimal metadata for the TaskCreate tool. IMPORTANT: TaskCreate already uses a 'metadata' parameter as an arbitrary user-data object. ATS metadata MUST be nested under the '_dgm' key within that existing metadata object to avoid collision. This schema describes the shape of metadata._dgm.

notes.nesting_collision: TaskCreate's existing 'metadata' field is user-controlled. ATS fields go at metadata._dgm.source, metadata._dgm.provenance — NOT at the top level of the metadata object.
notes.example_call: TaskCreate({ subject: '...', description: '...', metadata: { _dgm: { source: 'skill:...', provenance: { session_id: '...', caller_type: 'skill', caller_name: '...' } }, ...user_data } })
